run_docling_cli_tools: run the Docling CLI helper app to access model management commands
download_docling_models: download default Docling models (layout, tableformer, code_formula) to the cache directory
download_all_docling_models: download all available Docling models including VLM and MLX variants to a specified output directory
download_hf_models: download HuggingFace models (smolvlm, granitedocling, smoldocling) to a local directory
build_docling_typer_cli: build a Typer CLI app that exposes model download commands for Docling document processing
